lines.text: a part of me needs to know
but i know there’s nothing to do
ask each other for advice i don’t have
but they also all tell truths
so i’ll try to be true
the part that begrieves the end

n1.body:
this song was born from the desperation arising around my big brother being in a dangerous place at a dangerous time.

pretty self-explanatory

n2.body:
a time to be patient and find ways to hold oneself amid distress with no visible end
it can be immensely trying

n3.body: inner conflict, a desire for any certainty at all

n4.body: the experience of holding a paradox in your mind and heart. (only as i am writing this do i realize how switching back and forth between the same two chords multiple times in quick succession musically expresses this same feeling of being torn)

n5.body: a vital part of learning to accept something difficult, is to be real about how much i do not at all accept it. this part is also permitted to exist and i don't need to agree with it to remain calm and friendly.

n6.body: in some cases a person stuck in anxiety just needs to be held and loved as they are

n7.body:
invoking playfulness
in some cases distraction can be a productive, meaningful and necessary means to deliver us from misery.
